items.title: CSAIL news lists InstructMesh, a tool for editing and fabricating AI-generated 3D models
items.summary_en: A CSAIL news listing dated 2 November 2026 describes InstructMesh, a tool for editing AI-generated 3D models and preparing them for fabrication. Only the listing-level description was seen; methods, authors and results are unverified.
items.source_name: MIT CSAIL News (listing, via search snippet)
items.notes: Article URL not obtained. Based on a web-search snippet; direct fetch blocked in collection environment. Verify before use.

coverage_note: Severely limited: csail.mit.edu and news.mit.edu did not resolve. A Fortune report (2026-11-03, secondary) about CSAIL research on a model fine-tuning another model needs primary confirmation and was excluded.
